title: Arroz con Pollo
description: Chicken and golden rice cooked together in one pot with peppers, onion, tomato, peas and olives. A complete, comforting meal.
equipment: Large Dutch oven or deep skillet with a lid

image.alt: A pan of yellow rice with chicken, peas and red peppers

steps.text: Season the chicken with 1 tsp of the salt and the cumin. Heat the oil in the pot over medium-high heat and brown the chicken skin side down until golden, {time 6-8 min}. Turn and brown for {time 2 min}, then set aside.
Pour off all but 2 tbsp of the fat. Cook the onion and green pepper over medium heat until soft, {time 6 min}. Add the garlic, paprika, turmeric and tomato paste and stir for {time 1 min}.
Add the rice and stir until coated, {time 1 min}. Pour in the broth with the remaining salt and bring to a boil.
Nestle the chicken into the rice skin side up. Cover tightly, lower the heat and cook without lifting the lid until the rice is tender and the chicken reads {temp 175F internal}, {time 25-30 min}.
Scatter the peas and olives over the top, cover again and let stand off the heat for {time 10 min}. Fluff the rice, scatter with cilantro and serve.

notes: A tight lid is essential; if yours is loose, lay a sheet of foil under it.
